mnreOverview.agencyName: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
keyFunctions: Implementation of national solar schemes (PM-KUSUM, PM Surya Ghar)
Monitoring and target setting for installed capacity

schemes.name: PM-KUSUM Scheme
schemes.fullName: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan

components.name: Component A
components.description: 2 MW grid-connected solar power plants on barren or fallow farmland

components.name: Component B
components.description: Off-grid standalone solar pumps (2 to 10 HP) for agricultural irrigation

components.name: Component C
components.description: Grid-connected solar pumps and solarization of existing agricultural pumps

schemes.target: 30,800 MW total capacity, 25 lakh solar pumps
schemes.beneficiaries: Farmers, Agricultural Cooperatives, Water User Associations

schemes.name: National Solar Mission (NSM)
schemes.description: Part of India's National Action Plan on Climate Change to scale solar energy capacity to 500 GW non-fossil fuel by 2030.

schemes.name: Solar Park Scheme
schemes.description: Establishes Ultra-Mega Solar Power Projects (500 MW+) providing plug-and-play land and transmission infrastructure for developers.

schemes.name: CPSU Scheme Phase-II
schemes.description: Grid-connected rooftop and ground-mounted solar for Central Public Sector Undertakings using mandatory Domestic Content Requirement (DCR / Made in India) modules.

schemes.name: Green Energy Corridors (GEC)
schemes.description: Dedicated intra-state and inter-state transmission network for renewable energy evacuation across solar-rich states.

almmFramework.fullTitle: Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM)
almmFramework.purpose: Ensures quality and domestic content for solar PV modules installed under government-subsidized schemes.
almmFramework.list1: Solar PV Modules (Over 100 GW total approved capacity)
almmFramework.requirement: Mandatory for PM Surya Ghar, PM-KUSUM, and Government building solar installations.

ceaNetMeteringStandards.sanctionedLoadRule: Allowed AC inverter capacity for net metering must be evaluated against consumer's sanctioned load.
ceaNetMeteringStandards.meteringType: Bi-directional net meter measuring Import vs Export units.
